description: Put a picture into an empty picture spot a sample is waiting for (a stand-in person, a photo, a screen or a card's picture). key comes from samples "needs" or "add". Send a picture file from this computer (full path), or the address of a picture Dinoctor already has (starting with /, as generate or upload tools return). One undo step. To put a picture into a shot's cast or background instead, use upload or put_picture.

file.description: Full path of a png, jpg or webp.

key.description: The spot's key from samples "needs" or "add".

url.description: Or: a Dinoctor picture address starting with /.

name: fill_spot
